KEYS REQUIRED BEFORE PROCEEDING
You should have already collected your keys from 23 Lonsdale Street, Braddon before going to the property. If you don't have your keys yet, tap here for key collection instructions or call us on 0493 173 122.

Check-In Instructions

Choose your check-in route below.

Step 1
Your Keys
Your keyring has two items — a remote (opens the car park garage) and a standard door key (front door of the apartment). The remote also acts as your swipe card for building access readers.
Step 2
Enter the Building
Head to 65 Cooyong Street, Braddon. Look for the SOL at Founders Lane sign. Swipe your remote on the reader at the lobby entrance to enter.
Step 3
Take the Lift to Level 3
Take the lift to Level 3. Scan your remote on the reader inside the lift and press button 3.
Step 4
Find Apartment 307
Turn left out of the elevator and left again — Apartment 307 is located on the right hand side. Use your door key to enter. Enjoy your stay!
Step 1
Your Keys
Your keyring has two items — a remote (opens the car park garage) and a standard door key (front door of the apartment). The remote also acts as your swipe card for building access readers.
Step 2
Head to Founders Lane
Go to Founders Lane off Batman Street. Follow the map below — look for the SOL 61-65 Cooyong Street sign and turn left into the carpark entry.
Step 3
Turn Left into Founders Lane
Turn left into Founders Lane from Batman Street as shown. You will see the SOL sign and carpark entry ahead.
Step 4
Enter the Carpark
Turn left into the carpark entry. Use your remote to open the garage door.
Step 5
Follow Signs to B2
Follow signs to B2 and go down the second ramp. Your allocated car space is 307/65 — this is private and reserved for you.
Step 6
Head to the Elevator
Use the elevators to the left of your car space. Swipe your remote on the reader to access the lift.
Step 7
Swipe & Press Level 3
Swipe your remote on the door to access the elevators, then press Level 3.
Step 8
Press Level 3
Inside the lift, press Level 3.
Step 9
Find Apartment 307
Turn left out of the elevator and left again — Apartment 307 is located on the right hand side. Use your door key to enter. Enjoy your stay!
